evidence.note: David fathers לַשלֵימָונ by Uriah’s wife. The prefixed לַ marks Solomon as the child in the genealogy.
The promise names David’s son שְׁלֹמֹה and pairs his name with שָׁלוֹם, the peace God will give Israel in his days.

name: שלֵימָונ
summary: The Peshitta uses שלֵימָונ for David’s son Solomon. First Chronicles connects his Hebrew name with the peace Israel would enjoy in his days.
